name: Ash hound; ash hound alpha
review_status: Complete; awaiting Claude review. No shared approval files edited.

smooth_hide.note: Black hide has no design-specified exact hex; these are the production prompt choices.

locks: Lean, long-legged, wolf-sized quadruped; normal shoulder height 90 cm.
Smooth hairless matte black hide; ribs press beneath intact skin.
Completely eyeless and noseless elongated head; no eye glow or knight-style face hole.
Long split jaw lined with white bone-like teeth.
Thin dorsal cracks leak violet ash; do not treat hide as armour.
Canine digitigrade joints, four-toed clawed paws; long thin smooth tail and swept pointed canine ears as established by front.png.
Alpha remains the same species, shoulder height 160 cm, with heavier neck and deep neck/back cracks that flare violet as it howls.
The pack moves only when its alpha howls.
scale_policy: 27 October README override: no person or silhouette on front, turnaround, details or alpha sheets. pack.png includes an actual generic 178 cm adult silhouette beside the leading hounds in one shared scene.

references.policy: Every sheet after the front references the internally passed front first; no rejected image is used as an input. No old references or outside images.

production.format: Native 1536x1024 PNG; copied byte-for-byte from generated source, no art resizing or re-encoding.
production.inspection: Full-size generated images, 200 px thumbnails, and 200% nearest-neighbour inspection crops checked in memory. No inspection images saved to project.

caveats: Sheet background tone is slightly cooler/darker than requested #E9E9EC; faint background tone variation is permitted by the 27 October override.
Alpha's absolute real-world size is specified in metadata, with no drawn scale person as directed.
The pack scene demonstrates scale approximately through the adult and nearby leaders; no exact pixel measurement is claimed.
